literal: Poverty within poverty is turning away a guest; strength within strength is bearing with the foolish.
translation: The worst of poverty is turning away a guest; the greatest of strength is bearing with the foolish.
modern: வறுமையிலும் கொடிய வறுமை வீட்டிற்கு வந்த விருந்தினரைத் தவிர்ப்பது ஆகும்; வலிமையிலும் சிறந்த வலிமை அறிவற்றவர்களின் தீமைகளைப் பொறுத்துக் கொள்வது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares two extremes to highlight the supreme value of patience. It states that the ultimate form of poverty is not the lack of material wealth, but the inability to welcome and feed a guest. Conversely, the ultimate form of strength is not physical power, but the mental fortitude required to patiently endure the actions of ignorant or foolish people. Through this comparison, the poet elevates forbearance to the highest virtue of the strong.
